title: Bring your AppSec backlog to OWASP Global AppSec USA 2026
summary: Meet OpenText Fortify at OWASP Global AppSec USA 2026 in San Francisco, November 5–6. Bring your AppSec backlog to booth G11.
body_markdown:
AI coding agents and human developers are producing code faster than security teams can review it. The result is a familiar problem with new urgency: findings pile up, triage takes time, and developers need a clear path to the fixes that matter.


At[OWASP Global AppSec USA 2026](https://owasp.glueup.com/event/owasp-global-appsec-usa-2026-167174/) , November 5 and 6 in San Francisco, OpenText Fortify is bringing one question to the conversation: How ugly is your AppSec backlog?


## Find. Fix. Fortify.


Finding more issues is not enough if teams cannot act on them. **OpenText Fortify** combines established application security testing with practical AI capabilities to help teams move from detection to decisions and remediation.


**Find what conventional analysis can miss.** Fortify Agentic Analyzer complements static application security testing with deeper analysis of complex issues, including application logic and authorization flaws.


**Fix with better context.** Fortify Remediation Aviator helps teams audit and triage findings, understand the reasoning behind them, and work with contextual remediation guidance while retaining developer review.


**Fortify your testing foundation.** SAST, DAST, and software composition analysis address different parts of application risk. Together with AI analysis, they support testing across source code, running applications, and third-party components.


## Bring us your backlog


Whether your challenge is an overflowing findings queue, complex vulnerabilities, or keeping security aligned with AI-assisted development, come talk with the OpenText Fortify team at booth G11. Bring your toughest AppSec questions. We will discuss where proven testing and AI can help your team focus its effort.


## **Meet OpenText at OWASP Global AppSec**


**November 5–6 at the Hyatt Regency San Francisco**


Visit OpenText Fortify at Booth G11 to connect with our team and learn how we can help strengthen your application security program.
